releases.notes:
# 🎉 PromptCraft v1.0.0 - Initial Release

Transform your Minecraft world with AI-powered 3D generation! PromptCraft brings cutting-edge AI models directly into Minecraft, allowing you to create structures from simple text prompts.

---

## ✨ What's New

### 🚀 Multiple Generation Modes
- **Generate Mode**: Fast 3D generation (~30 seconds) using Z-Image + SAM-3D
- **Craft Mode**: High-quality UV-textured models (~2-3 minutes) using Nano Banana Pro + Hunyuan 3D
- **Stream Mode**: Watch structures emerge from noise in real-time
- **Legacy Mode**: UV-textured models using Meshy-6 (~7 minutes)

### 🎮 Features
- **Ghost Block Preview**: See your structure before placing it
- **Full 3D Rotation**: Rotate around all axes (yaw, pitch, roll)
- **Position Adjustment**: Move structures up and down
- **Smart Block Mapping**: Perceptual color matching with 100+ block palette
- **Animated Building**: Watch blocks place layer-by-layer

### 🎯 Commands
```
/fal generate <size> <prompt>        - Fast 3D generation
/fal craft <size> <prompt>           - High-quality craft mode
/fal stream <size> <prompt>          - Live streaming generation
/fal generate legacy <size> <prompt> - Legacy mode
/fal setkey <key>                    - Configure API key
/fal status                          - Check configuration
```

---

## 📥 Installation

### Requirements
- **Minecraft**: 1.21.1
- **Fabric Loader**: 0.17.3 or higher ([Download](https://fabricmc.net/use/))
- **Fabric API**: 0.107.0 or higher ([Download](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api/version/0.116.7+1.21.1))
- **Java**: 21 or higher
- **fal.ai API Key**: Free key available at [fal.ai/dashboard/keys](https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys)

### Step-by-Step Installation

#### 1. Install Fabric Loader
1. Download Fabric Installer from [fabricmc.net](https://fabricmc.net/use/)
2. Run the installer and select Minecraft 1.21.1
3. Click "Install"
4. Launch Minecraft and select the "Fabric" profile

#### 2. Install Required Mods
1. Download **PromptCraft** (this mod) - `promptcraft-1.0.0.jar`
2. Download **Fabric API** from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api/version/0.116.7+1.21.1)
3. Place both JAR files in your `.minecraft/mods/` folder
   - **Windows**: `%APPDATA%\.minecraft\mods\`
   - **macOS**: `~/Library/Application Support/minecraft/mods/`
   - **Linux**: `~/.minecraft/mods/`

#### 3. Get Your API Key
1. Go to [fal.ai/dashboard/keys](https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys)
2. Sign up for a free account
3. Create a new API key
4. Copy the key (you'll need it in-game)

#### 4. Launch Minecraft
1. Start Minecraft with the Fabric profile
2. Join a world (single-player or multiplayer)
3. Configure your API key:
   ```
   /fal setkey "YOUR_API_KEY_HERE"
   ```
   ⚠️ **Important**: Include the quotes around your API key!

#### 5. Verify Installation
```
/fal status
```
You should see: "✓ API Key: Configured"

---

## 🎮 Quick Start Guide

### Your First Generation

1. **Look at where you want to place the structure** (up to 200 blocks away)

2. **Run a generation command**:
   ```
   /fal generate 48 medieval castle with towers
   ```

3. **Wait ~30 seconds** for the AI to generate your structure

4. **Adjust the preview**:
   - Press **G** to rotate (yaw)
   - Press **V** to pitch (tilt forward/back)
   - Press **B** to roll (tilt sideways)
   - Press **H** to move up
   - Press **N** to move down

5. **Place the structure**:
   - **Right-click** to confirm and build
   - Watch it build layer-by-layer!

### Example Prompts

**Architecture**:
```
/fal generate 64 gothic cathedral with stained glass
/fal craft 80 japanese pagoda temple
/fal stream 96 futuristic skyscraper
```

**Characters**:
```
/fal craft 64 spongebob squarepants
/fal generate 48 medieval knight statue
/fal craft 80 pikachu pokemon
```

**Creatures**:
```
/fal craft 112 epic fire dragon with wings
/fal generate 64 phoenix bird rising
/fal stream 80 mechanical robot warrior
```

**Vehicles**:

/fal generate 64 pirate ship with sails
